ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the diagram, it is known that $ \angle AOC : \angle BOC = 1 : 5$, $OD$ bisects $\angle AOB$, and $\angle COD = 36^\circ$. What is the degree measure of $\angle AOB$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Let $\angle AOC=x$, then $\angle BOC=5x$,\\
since $OD$ bisects $\angle AOB$,\\
thus $\angle AOD=\frac{1}{2}\angle AOB=\frac{1}{2}(x+5x)=3x$,\\
also, since $\angle COD=\angle AOD-\angle AOC$,\\
thus $3x-x=36^\circ$,\\
solving this, we get $x=18^\circ$,\\
therefore $\angle AOB=\angle AOC+\angle BOC=x+5x=\boxed{108^\circ}$.
